selected_problem: Fresh canonical main revalidated duplicate/overlap path sets at apply, but still trusted each persisted path string as already canonical. A staged new-file write could be redirected inside the workspace by rewriting src/original.mjs to src/../redirected.mjs while leaving the staged preimage/postimage metadata unchanged; safePath resolved the rewritten target and apply performed the redirected write.
decision_basis: Stage already canonicalizes change paths and rejects empty, dot, parent-escape, absolute, and drive-qualified paths. Requiring the durable path string to remain exactly equal to that canonical form is preservation of an existing stage invariant.
The defect is directly falsifiable without changing hashes, bytes, or trust policy because a non-existing-file preimage remains valid after an in-workspace path redirection.
Hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained temporarily unavailable with HTTP 502; this cycle used DWAC_SOURCE_CONTRACT_REPLAY（DWAC 源码契约重放） and exact local focused validation.

pre_fix_reality.focused_reproduction: EXPECTED_FAILURE: apply accepted src/../redirected.mjs and created redirected.mjs even though stage had approved src/original.mjs.
pre_fix_reality.impact: The durable STAGED artifact could change its actual workspace target after approval without changing the staged preimage or postimage payload.

change: Apply now recomputes the same lexical path normalization used by stage, rejects stage-invalid forms, and requires the persisted path string to already equal the canonical result before path-set, operation, image, or workspace checks proceed.

validation.node_check: PASS on the exact proposed core/changesets.mjs content
validation.focused_tests: 8/8 PASS, 0 skipped across apply-preimage, operation, path-set, and path-canonicality integrity
validation.canonical_roundtrip: PASS: a canonical persisted path still applies and rolls back exactly

truth_boundary: This preserves stage-time lexical path canonicality across durable reload. It does not authenticate the chosen canonical path against a coherent rewrite of the complete changeset or decide filesystem case/Unicode identity semantics.
